instagram.author: nick_saraev
instagram.body:
Comment "AUDIO" to get this Free and Open-source AI Audio Generator. 

Forget ElevenLabs. Use this new free AI voice model instead. 

It clones your voice with just 3 seconds of audio. You get unlimited realistic dialogues. And it's all free.

It's called Qwen 3. This model leads open-source text-to-speech right now. 

Think of it like a voice copy machine. You feed in a short clip. It spits out your exact sound.

Create new voices easily. Just describe what you want. Adjust tone. Set the rhythm. 

Pick a persona. Like making a custom radio host from scratch.

It has 50 built-in voices too. They sound full of feeling. 

Supports 10 languages. English works great. Hindi fits your needs. Others join the list.

Run it offline on your computer. Use Hugging Face for setup. 

The good news? You control it fully. No internet required after install.

Want to try online first? Head to this website. 

Upload audio there. Type your text. Hear results fast.

Here's how it helps your work:

1. Make YouTube videos quicker
2. Build AI apps with real voices
3. Test ideas without costs

I tried it last week. Gave it 3 seconds of my voice. 

Asked for a story teller tone. The output fooled my friends. Setup took under 10 minutes.

Even short clips work well. Split long scripts into parts. 

Generate each one fast. Stitch them together later.

Qwen 3 fits any project. Videos need narration? Done. 

Apps need chat voices? Easy. The free part means no limits. 

You experiment as much as you like.

Grab it today. Your content sounds better already.

#aiaudio #aivoicecloning #elevenlabs #opensourceai #aivoice
